name: play_store_get_app_star_rating
intent: Look up an app's star rating in the Google Play Store
description: Searches the Google Play Store for a named app and reads the average star rating shown on its listing, without installing the app or signing in.
patterns: what is the star rating of an app
how many stars does an app have
check an app's Play Store rating
what rating does an app have on Google Play

steps.intent: Tap Search to start looking up an app
